info.title: Identity Fullstack Reference API
info.description: Production-grade reference implementation of authentication and authorization with ASP.NET Core 10 Identity, ES256 JWT, rotating refresh tokens, and server-evaluated policies.

get.summary: Public JSON Web Key Set for verifying ES256 tokens

post.summary: Confirm email address using token from URL fragment
Complete sign in with TOTP or recovery code
Exchange rotating refresh token for a fresh token pair
Complete password reset with verification token
Revoke all sessions for current user

get.summary: Evaluate all authorization policies for current caller

post.summary: Update password and revoke all other sessions

get.summary: Generate shared TOTP key and otpauth URI

post.summary: Verify TOTP code, enable 2FA, issue recovery codes, and step-up token
Disable 2FA (forbidden for accounts holding admin permissions)

get.summary: List all notes belonging to the current user

delete.summary: Delete note (owner or moderator with MFA)

get.summary: Query users with search, role filters, and pagination

post.summary: Temporarily lock user account and revoke their sessions

put.summary: Update user role assignments and revoke their sessions

post.summary: Revoke all active sessions for a target user
Trigger email confirmation dispatch for user

get.summary: List all system roles and their assigned permission claims
Query security audit log with filters and pagination
Query all notes across users for moderation purposes

AdminStatsResponse.description: System security and user statistics for admin panel overview.

AdminUserResponse.description: Admin view of a user profile.

AuthResponse.description: Authentication result response returned to clients/BFF.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Request payload for updating user password.

ConfirmEmailRequest.description: Request payload for confirming email with token from fragment.

CreateNoteRequest.description: Request payload for creating a new note.

DisableTwoFactorRequest.description: Request payload for disabling two-factor authentication.

EnableTwoFactorRequest.description: Request payload for verifying and enabling two-factor authentication.

EnableTwoFactorResponse.description: Response containing newly generated one-time recovery codes and fresh tokens.

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Request payload for initiating password reset.

PolicyEvaluationItem.description: Server-evaluated policy item with allowance state and explicit reason.

RecoveryCodesResponse.description: Response containing freshly regenerated one-time recovery codes.

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Request payload for exchanging a rotating refresh token.

ResendConfirmationRequest.description: Request payload for resending email confirmation link.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Request payload for resetting password using verification token.

TwoFactorLoginRequest.description: Request payload for completing two-factor login.

TwoFactorSetupResponse.description: Setup payload for configuring two-factor authentication.

UpdateNoteRequest.description: Request payload for updating an existing note.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Request payload for updating user profile information.

UpdateUserRolesRequest.description: Request payload for updating user roles.

UserSummaryResponse.description: User summary included in authentication responses.
